# Off-GPU inventory

**GPU 100% target: every site below ticked off, nothing off the GPU.**

Generated by `node scripts/off-gpu-scan.mjs --doc` (`npm run offgpu`); do not edit by hand. The checklist at the end is regenerated from the scan, so a site leaves it when it moves to the GPU.
No percentage blocks a push or a deploy; the honest score is printed and the target is 100%. What each category means is at the top of the script.

## Rare-branch allocations (1730), left out of the count

Allocations a frame path reaches only on a branch that never runs per frame (first use, a changed key, a resize, a context loss), marked `// alloc-rare: <reason>` in the source. Listed in full with the reason; a marker without a reason does not count.

| File:line | Function | What |
|---|---|---|
| src/engine/events.js:59 | collDetail | template string with a value — rare: only when a collateral event fires (a share crossed its cut and held), never per frame |
| src/engine/events.js:84 | breathAveraged | object literal — rare: only when the average starts over (a new engine, a reset or a restored state clears evAvg) |
| src/engine/events.js:114 | detectEvents | object literal — rare: once per engine |
| src/engine/events.js:121 | detectEvents | object literal — rare: only the first time a condition is seen (and after a reset or a restored state, which clear evState) |
| src/engine/events.js:127 | detectEvents | object literal — rare: only when an event fires (a condition crossed its cut and held), never per frame |
| src/engine/metrics.js:63 | spareOf | object literal — rare: made once for a record |
